_comment: The file every copy of Purrformance reads once at start-up. Edit it here,
commit, push -- that is the whole deployment. Raw GitHub serves it within a
minute or two, and the mod asks with Cache-Control: no-cache so it is not
Everything in it is optional. An empty {} means: current version, nobody
blocked, carry on. If the mod cannot reach this file it carries on too --
see the comment at the top of Gate.java for why that is on purpose.
latest  the newest version there is. Anybody on an older one is shown the
message below, once, shortly after they join a world. Compared
number by number, so 1.0.0 < 1.0.1 < 1.1.0. It must match the
mod_version in gradle.properties of the build you released.
message what those players are told. Keep it to a line -- it lands in chat.
url     tacked onto the end of the message, for where to get it.
blocked accounts the mod refuses to run for. uuid is the one that lasts;
name also works and stops working the day they rename. reason is
shown to them word for word, so write it as something a person
reads. Removing an entry lets them back in the next time they
start the game -- it is not one-way.
message: A newer Purrformance is out. Grab it before the next session.

blocked._example: Delete this entry. It is here to show the shape.
